name: dsh-approval-preflight
description: Graph-first permission preflight for DeepSeek Harness: the model declares a computation graph whose nodes carry the semantic operation (download what to where, write what, delete what); the user approves nodes one by one in a side panel, one approval covers one successful execution, uncovered operations still use the native approval card, and every node keeps an audit trail of what actually ran. / 先交计算图、逐节点批准的审批预检：节点写清这件事的本质，用户按节点一次性批准，执行成功即消耗、失败可重试；未申报的操作仍走原生卡，节点内实际跑过什么留有审计痕迹。
author: Making-acid

scripts.test: node scripts/selftest.mjs && node scripts/contract-test.mjs && node scripts/client-test.mjs
